_what: Every Higgsfield video generation on this account, matched to the local files that hold it. Byte-size match against every video on disk; the cache copy is named by generation id, the used_in paths are the human-named copies in project folders.
_why: No local file recorded which generation produced it. Without this, a clip on disk could not be traced to its prompt or its cost, and 65 of 89 generations looked lost when only 5 were.
